# Historical Shift-return acquisition v1 — NOT a qualified evaluation bank

Exact-byte copies of the accepted historical bank, fixtures, assignment, sources,
quota ledger and validation result. Original synthetic task prose is covered by
this repository's AGPL-3.0-only terms; underlying dictionary notices and source
licenses are preserved in the complete evidence archives.

1,500 tasks were accepted by two actual AI annotators (750 return, 750 literal).
They form 372 components: 209 train, 74 dev, 69 test, 20 regression. Test contrast
has only 69 components, below the fixed 100 requirement; other acquisition quotas
are incomplete. The actual validator exited 3. No quality enumeration, model
training, dev selection or final test occurred. These are explicit synthetic
intent tasks, not real passwords, user traces or natural-frequency observations.

Do not relabel this as a frozen or qualified formal run. `sources.json` and other
historical records retain original absolute paths and hashes. Do not rewrite
historical locks to make a different machine pass. Restore the archived layout or
create separately versioned relocation metadata. The three mandatory compatibility
fixtures were statically reviewed, not replayed and not new held-out samples.

Complete authoring scripts, rejected proposals, initial/revised annotations,
semantic/template alias decisions, retired/new IDs, exact input copies, earlier
closures and integrity manifests are in the `shift-return-records` archive under
`../experiment-archive-20261102/`. Its index records every file's SHA-256.
Read `../../design/experiment-handover.md` before continuing.
